summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing engagement of INFOR Financial to provide an independent fairness opinion to its special committee regarding an unsolicited all-share takeover bid (the Hostile Bid) by American Eagle Gold Corp. The board had previously recommended shareholders not tender to the Hostile Bid. INFOR Financial's compensation is a fixed fee not contingent on the outcome. The filing updates the company's defense against a hostile bid but does not itself constitute a deal, tender offer, or definitive agreement. Watch for the fairness opinion and further shareholder responses to the hostile bid.
